purpose: State clear limits so Divine Pattern research does not overclaim.

boundaries.claim_limit: Patterns do not mathematically prove God.
boundaries.why: Pattern recognition can support wonder, interpretation, and inquiry, but proof-language must not exceed source scope.

boundaries.claim_limit: Patterns do not replace Scripture or revelation.
boundaries.why: Christian doctrine is grounded in God's self-disclosure, not in human pattern detection.
Trinity, incarnation, providence, suffering, and new creation exceed full creaturely explanation.

boundaries.claim_limit: Patterns do not defeat every rival explanation.
boundaries.why: Psychology, sociology, biology, culture, politics, and literary form may explain many repeated signals.

boundaries.claim_limit: Patterns do not make suffering easy to explain.
boundaries.why: The project must preserve lament, protest, patience, justice, and eschatological hope without premature closure.

boundaries.claim_limit: Patterns do not certify institutions, leaders, or movements as faithful.
boundaries.why: Visible growth, order, or influence can coexist with corruption and harm.
